heading: Client classes that call the server
body: Use HTTPClient on a client class whose methods have empty bodies: a client is a contract with no implementation, and Tachyon writes each request. Use GetRequest, PostRequest, PutRequest, PatchRequest or DeleteRequest on its methods. Needs injects the client into a service without a constructor. Browser JavaScript and TypeScript clients send bounded JSON to the same origin. They reject redirects, send no credentials and cancel when their owner is disposed. Other languages declare the client as a contract (an interface, trait, protocol or abstract interface class), and its Setup configures the HTTP adapter. A Service cannot also be an HTTPClient (TY1308). Browser cache defaults to no-store. Select cache-first, network-first or reload for bounded anonymous IndexedDB storage. Every policy keeps the privacy, expiry and cancellation checks. Inject cacheManager to invalidate saved reads after writes. See the [routing annotation glossary](/docs/routing-annotations). Another host needs its name in `tac.outgoing.hosts` or `outgoing.hosts`; Tachyon refuses every other host when it builds and when it runs (`TY1326`).
